Spacecraft BeEagleSat (TR01)
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 2U
Status Reentry 2019-04-27. Was semi-operational? (Last JA0CAW report 2019-04-25. SatNOGS has green reports after decay)
Launched 2017-04-18
NORAD ID 42736
Deployer NRCSD (NanoRacks CubeSat Deployer) [Quad-M]
Launcher Atlas V (QB50)
Deployment Deployed from ISS on 2017-05-27
Organization ITU (Istanbul Technical University)
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Nation Turkey
Launch brokerer Nanoracks
Partners QB50, Turkish Air Force Academy
Oneliner

Part of QB50 to study lower termosphere.
Description

Primary payload is a multi-needle langmuir probe, which will measure electron density during mission. Secondary payload is a semiconductor based x-ray detector, which will measure x-ray levels for various altitudes. QB50.
